nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Delhi government financial assistance programme supporting eligible patients for specified costly treatments and medical conditions.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Delhi residence, income and medical/treatment criteria notified for the relevant assistance component.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Delhi Arogya Kosh.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
